hooks.command: (bd list --status in_progress --json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]') | jq -c 'if length > 0 then {systemMessage: ("⚠️  " + (length|tostring) + " bd issue(s) left in_progress — close or update before ending the session:\n" + ([.[] | "  - " + .id + ": " + .title] | join("\n")))} else empty end'
